worst_moment: "Yes, 72 km/h is 20 m/s, and 20 times 5 is 100 meters. Write that down and keep going." - fine but slightly redundant; there is no real weak turn.
best_moment: "Because 1 kilometer is 1000 meters and 1 hour is 3600 seconds, so 72 km/h is 72 times 1000 meters per 3600 seconds." - answers the why with the real unit reasoning and lets the student derive 3.6 themselves.
